def solve():
    h, n = map(int, input().split())
    
    # At each level, track command parity and which subtree n is in
    # leaves are 1..2^h
    
    count = 0
    lo, hi = 1, 1 << h  # leaf range of current subtree
    cmd = 0  # 0=L, 1=R
    
    for depth in range(h + 1):
        count += 1  # visit current node
        if depth == h:
            # at leaf = exit, don't count it
            count -= 1
            break
        
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        subtree_size = (1 << (h - depth - 1 + 1)) - 1  # nodes in child subtree = 2^(h-depth) - 1... 
        # child subtree height = h - depth - 1, nodes = 2^(h-depth) - 1
        child_nodes = (1 << (h - depth)) - 1
        
        if cmd == 0:  # L first
            if n <= mid:  # n in left subtree
                hi = mid
            else:  # n in right subtree, visit entire left first
                count += child_nodes
                lo = mid + 1
        else:  # R first
            if n > mid:  # n in right subtree
                lo = mid + 1
            else:  # n in left subtree, visit entire right first
                count += child_nodes
                hi = mid
        
        cmd = 1 - cmd
    
    print(count)

solve()
